name: Modern Men's Briefs
summary: The short, knitted, elastic-waist brief with a Y-shaped overlapping fly that Coopers, Inc. of Kenosha launched in 1935, and that replaced the loose drawers and the union suit.

philosophy.core_thesis: A man's underwear gives support and freedom of movement. A short knitted brief with a sewn-in waist is better than a loose drawer or a long suit.
design_principles: Knit the body of combed cotton in a close, soft jersey, with a stretch in both directions.
Cut the leg short and high, with an edge at the upper thigh.
Sew an elastic waistband into the top edge, 3 to 4 cm wide.
Sew a Y-shaped seam at the front, so that two layers overlap at the fly.
Make the front pouch of a double layer of cloth for support.
Finish each seam flat, with no ridge against the skin.
Keep the colour to white, grey or a plain tone.
anti_patterns: A long, loose drawer tied with a string
A one-piece union suit with long legs
A woven cloth with no stretch
A wide-cut boxer with a loose leg
A printed, patterned or logo waistband

silhouette.shape: A short, close brief with a high-cut leg and a flat elastic waist.
silhouette.line: A clean, level waist line and a curved leg line at the upper thigh.
silhouette.fit: Close and supportive; the knit stretches with the body and the waistband holds the brief in place.
silhouette.proportion: Rise 22 to 28 cm; leg opening at the upper thigh; waistband 3 to 4 cm wide.
rules: Cut the front in two layers, with an overlap that forms the Y seam.
Sew a flat elastic waistband to the top edge.
Bind the leg openings with a narrow knitted band.
Keep the back in one piece, with no seam at the centre.
Print or weave the maker's name on the waistband only.

fabrics.rule: Knit the body in combed cotton, and set an elastic webbing in the waist; use woven poplin only for the boxer.

methods: cotton jersey knitted in the round
elastic webbing sewn into the waistband
construction.closures: No closure: the waistband is elastic, and the Y-shaped fly overlaps and stays shut without a button.
construction.details: A maker's name on the waistband, a small label at the back, and a flat seam at the leg.

surface.pattern: Plain white in most years; plain grey, navy or black from the 1950s; stripe or check only in a woven boxer.
surface.gloss: Jersey at 2–6 GU; mercerised cotton at 8–14 GU.
surface.wear: Washed cotton softens and shrinks a little; the waistband elastic loses its grip first.

palette.strategy: White for the standard brief; a few plain colours from the 1950s, always one tone and no pattern.

processes: cutting of the body in layers
overlap seam sewn at the fly
elastic waistband set by a machine
pressing and packing in a box
making.scale: Made in a knitting mill in large lots; the brief launched in 1935 in a department store and then sold across the country.
making.signs: A Y-shaped seam at the front, an elastic waistband with a name, a double front, and a short, high leg.

pieces.form: Y-front brief of combed cotton jersey with an elastic waistband
Plain brief in grey marl cotton with bound legs
Woven boxer with an elastic waist and a button fly
Union suit of brushed cotton, the older form that the brief replaced

positive: flat packshot on a plain ground

canonical_works.work: Promotional statuette for the Y-front brief

evidence.title: Plaster promotional statuette for the Y-front brief, 1940

lineage.root: The brief begins the men's line of the underwear branch. The older men's drawer and union suit are not styles in the data, and no earlier style of the branch fits.

emotion.target_response: A sense of comfort and plain good sense: a clean, close garment that supports and does not show.

use_cases: a flat product shot of cotton basics
a museum label or object study
avoid_when: the brief wants a designer logo waistband
the brief wants silk or lace

modifiers.how: Weave a large name into the elastic, and keep the cotton jersey and the plain colour.
Knit the body from nylon and elastane, bond the edges, and lengthen the leg; drop the Y seam.

ornament_level.note: The brief is plain; only the name on the waistband adds ornament.
